title: Dennis Phelps Holding Baby in Yard, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-20th century outdoor snapshot featuring a sharply dressed man identified on the reverse as Dennis Phelps, wearing an overcoat and necktie, gently cradling an infant wrapped in a soft white knit outfit and blanket. They stand on a spacious residential yard with mature evergreen and deciduous trees, a pole, and a porch-front house visible in the background.
